method.checksumSyntax: Strict unescaped GNU text/binary format; every unsupported line is a failure. No blank or comment lines are silently skipped.
method.testIdentity: Published tests compared byte hashes with preserved executed source and exact git testCommit blobs; original adapter archive compared with production source git blob.
method.productionSource: Stored resource and signing receipt production identifiers checked; no new APK verification claim.

limitations: Only explicitly listed checksum files are checked; this is not a complete application inventory audit.
Original 1-95 checksum audit is referenced, not rerun or retroactively claimed to use this script.
Test source identity and archived metadata do not alone prove a test run; existing canonical QA reports remain the execution evidence.
No game replay, model test rerun, video decode, cryptographic signature validation, or physical TV/phone test was performed.
